name: After § 116
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the UN Climate Change Conference 2025 in Belém, Brazil (COP30)
part_text: 116a. Recognises that the EU’s climate law and corresponding policy measures are significantly affecting Member State’s choices between different energy sources and threaten their energy security and energy supply; calls on the Council and the Commission to pursue a pragmatic climate policy that ensures the EU’s energy security, affordable energy prices for EU citizens and businesses and the EU’s competitiveness;
